summary: The Public flood view of the design (PLAN-5 4.4) is built and checked on the fixture server and on a real live flood (Grand River flood, Missouri) through the real API. The hazard circle is split into HazardDisc (thermal or water texture); the fire circle, title and chip draw byte-identical markup (checked before and after) and the fire view screenshot matches brief 4 apart from live ages. The water circle draws the design's SVG verbatim, still under reduced motion, with NWS product status words and one meaning per status. Facts per kind (river, flash/areal, watch only) come from official answers and member gauges only, each with issuer, own time and link; absence sentences only for available answers. The key names each layer with its own time (ages at render), the no-view hatch and the image edge; the map draws the satellite water image with its edge, the NWS forecast flooded area, NWS warning areas (products at the handle's time), the main channel, the flood's gauges and a FEMA toggle off by default; never the model or CatFIM. The leader ends at the primary member gauge or, for a flash flood, at a point of its largest NWS polygon. The point card gains a flood-view block (location/floodCheck.ts). The official flood web (floodModel, floodHooks with the shared useFloodOfficial store, FloodOfficialNow, FloodEvacRows in flood wording) and FloodLayersPanel are ready for Command. startFloodBuild, job polling and the manifest reload work against the real build route (a real flood prepared end to end). Review fixes (review5-web-flood-public.json, WFP-R1..R12): failed or loading satellite and forecast-area answers are said in the key, status, legend and point card (NOTHING_COVERS waits for every layer); one reading per gauge (the newer of the list and the gauges answer) for the leader diamond, stage row and map label; the image edge follows the satellite answer; amber stale facts; outage rows keep "not an all-clear"; the flood layers credited in the foot when the key is hidden; product time and link on the detection, damage and watch rows; snow, ocean and clear pixels never read as "no water"; build polling survives failed polls.
